Leaf expressions: variables and parameters

Source: R/sparsediff-atoms.R
sparsediff-leaves.Rd

Create the leaves of an expression graph. A variable is a slice of the differentiation vector; a parameter is fixed data that can be updated between evaluations (see sd_register_params).

Arguments

d1, d2

row and column dimensions of the leaf.

var_id

0-based flat (column-major) offset of this variable's first entry within the primal vector u.

param_id

0-based parameter offset, analogous to var_id.

n_vars

total number of variables in the problem.

values

numeric data for the parameter (length d1 * d2, column-major).

Value

An expression handle.

See also

sparsediff-elementwise, sd_problem
